findings.evidence: Structure at line 111 has only `isOrthogonal`/`fixes_left`/`fixes_right`; the only companion lemma in the `Bilin` block is `reflection_isPairStabilizer` (line 121). Grep of the file shows the two anonymous-constructor sites above.
findings.fix: Add `Bilin.isPairStabilizer_id (g : Bilin V) (a b : V) : IsPairStabilizer g a b LinearMap.id` and `Bilin.IsPairStabilizer.comp : IsPairStabilizer g a b f → IsPairStabilizer g a b f' → IsPairStabilizer g a b (f ∘ₗ f')` next to `reflection_isPairStabilizer`, and use them at lines 1229 and 1013-1016.
findings.issue: `Bilin.IsPairStabilizer` is introduced as a general stabilizer notion but ships without its monoid API: the identity is a pair stabilizer and a composite of pair stabilizers is one. Both are proved inline in this same file — line 1229 (`⟨by rw [LinearMap.id_coe]; exact LinearMap.isOrthogonal_id gWit, rfl, rfl⟩`) and lines 1014-1016 (`⟨by rw [LinearMap.coe_comp]; exact h₁.isOrthogonal.comp h₂.isOrthogonal, by rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, h₂.fixes_left, h₁.fixes_left], …⟩`) — so every downstream consumer that builds a stabilizer element other than a reflection must re-derive them.

findings.evidence: Lines 130-132 (`span : ∀ v, ∃ x y u, g a u = 0 ∧ g b u = 0 ∧ …`) versus lines 879 and 882-884; the `Bilin` block contains no `symm` lemma for `IsSpectatorSplit`. The pre-PR `SpectatorSplitting.span` stated `g K.q u = 0 ∧ g (pTransverse g K) u = 0`, matching `definite`, so this PR creates the mismatch.
findings.fix: Either reorder the `definite`/`transitive`/`self_ne_zero_of_spectator` hypotheses to the `(p_T, q)` order of the inherited `span`, or add `Bilin.IsSpectatorSplit.symm : IsSpectatorSplit g a b → IsSpectatorSplit g b a` (pure re-association, no symmetry hypothesis needed) and expose it as the bridge.
findings.issue: `Hadronic.SpectatorAssumptions` now `extends Bilin.IsSpectatorSplit g (pTransverse g K) K.q`, whose `span` yields `g p_T u = 0 ∧ g q u = 0`, while its own `definite` (line 879), `transitive` (line 882) and `SpectatorAssumptions.self_ne_zero_of_spectator` (line 887) still take the orthogonality hypotheses in the opposite `(q, p_T)` order. One structure's public fields therefore disagree on slot order, and `Bilin.IsSpectatorSplit` carries no lemma to bridge it — every consumer shuffles arguments by hand, as the diff itself does (`obtain ⟨a, b, u, huT, huq, rfl⟩ := hS.span v` then `hS.definite … huq huT`).

summary: The exposed surface is otherwise clean — no compatibility shims, bodies unexposed with `_iff`/`_def` restatements supplied — but the two new general `Bilin` notions ship without their basic API: `IsPairStabilizer` has no `id`/`comp` lemmas although the file proves both inline, and `IsSpectatorSplit` has no slot-swap lemma while `Hadronic.SpectatorAssumptions` now mixes the two slot orders in one structure.
